##### Project general facts

Ramhan Island Villas Phase 2 is an exclusive waterfront villa development by Eagle Hills, located in Abu Dhabi and offering a refined collection of 2 to 5-bedroom residences. The project embodies a luxurious island lifestyle where contemporary architecture is seamlessly integrated with the natural coastal environment. Designed with elegant proportions, open layouts, and floor-to-ceiling openness, each villa reflects a sophisticated balance between modern living and serene seaside surroundings.

The development offers a curated selection of premium amenities focused on wellness, relaxation, and outdoor living. Residents can enjoy tranquil landscaped spaces, lush greenery, and dedicated areas for leisure and recreation, all set within a peaceful island environment. The highlight of the community is its private beachfront experience, allowing residents to enjoy the sea, fresh breeze, and water features in a calm and exclusive setting designed for comfort and privacy.

The interiors are finished with high-quality materials, including marble flooring in entry, living, dining, kitchens, and bathrooms, engineered wood in bedrooms, and ceramic tiles in utility areas. The villas feature solid wood entrance doors and stained veneer internal doors, adding a refined touch throughout. The kitchens are fully equipped, while the units are delivered unfurnished, with additional inclusions such as air conditioning units, water heaters, built-in cabinets, wardrobes, and walk-in closets for enhanced functionality and comfort.

##### Location description and benefits 

Ramhan Island is an exclusive natural island located off the coast of Abu Dhabi, offering a rare blend of seclusion, waterfront living, and close proximity to the city’s main attractions. Surrounded by pristine waters and untouched mangroves, the island provides a peaceful escape from the urban environment while still maintaining convenient access to Abu Dhabi mainland via well-connected road links.

The location is positioned within a serene coastal ecosystem, where residents can enjoy uninterrupted sea views, natural beaches, and a calm island atmosphere. Its strategic setting allows easy reach to key destinations such as Yas Island, Saadiyat Island, and Abu Dhabi International Airport, making it both a private retreat and a highly accessible address.

Ramhan Island is designed as a premium lifestyle destination, combining luxury waterfront living with nature-inspired surroundings. The area is envisioned as a low-density, high-end community focused on privacy, exclusivity, and outdoor living, where residents can experience a resort-style environment year-round.
